obligations.title: Closing Statement due
obligations.description: Buyer delivers its calculation of Closing Working Capital, Cash and Indebtedness.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the Closing Date, Buyer shall prepare and deliver to the Sellers' Representative a statement (the "Closing Statement") setting forth Buyer's good faith calculation of Closing Working Capital, Closing Cash and Closing Indebtedness.

obligations.title: Closing Statement objection deadline
obligations.description: Sellers' Representative must object within 45 days of delivery or the Closing Statement becomes binding.
obligations.source_quote: If the Sellers' Representative does not deliver an Objection Notice prior to the expiration of the Review Period, the Closing Statement shall be final and binding on the parties.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Closing Statement becomes final and binding.

obligations.title: Adjustment escrow release
obligations.description: Joint instruction to the Escrow Agent: any shortfall to Buyer, the balance of the $1.5M Adjustment Escrow to Sellers. Earliest date shown assumes no objection.
obligations.source_quote: Within five (5) Business Days after the final determination of the Closing Statement, (i) if the Final Purchase Price is less than the Estimated Purchase Price, Buyer and the Sellers' Representative shall jointly instruct the Escrow Agent to release to Buyer from the Adjustment Escrow Amount the amount of such shortfall, and (ii) the Escrow Agent shall release the remaining Adjustment Escrow Amount to the Sellers.
obligations.due_date_basis: 'Closing Statement objection deadline' + 5 business days (weekends skipped; holidays not modeled)

obligations.title: Indemnity escrow: first release (50%)
obligations.description: $4.5M (50% of the $9M Indemnity Escrow) goes to Sellers, less pending good-faith claims.
obligations.source_quote: On the date that is twelve (12) months after the Closing Date, the Escrow Agent shall release to the Sellers fifty percent (50%) of the Indemnity Escrow Amount, less the aggregate amount of all then-pending claims for indemnification made in good faith by Buyer.

obligations.title: Indemnity escrow: final release
obligations.description: Remaining Indemnity Escrow balance goes to Sellers, less pending good-faith claims. Buyer must have any claims on file before this date.
obligations.source_quote: On the date that is eighteen (18) months after the Closing Date (the "Final Release Date"), the Escrow Agent shall release to the Sellers the remaining balance of the Indemnity Escrow Amount, less the aggregate amount of all then-pending claims for indemnification made in good faith by Buyer.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Unclaimed escrow is released; Buyer loses its secured recovery source.

obligations.title: FY2025 Earnout Statement due
obligations.description: Buyer delivers its calculation of FY2025 Net Revenue to the Sellers' Representative.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the end of each of Fiscal Year 2025 and Fiscal Year 2026, Buyer shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative a statement setting forth its calculation of Net Revenue for such Fiscal Year (each, an "Earnout Statement").

obligations.title: FY2025 earnout dispute window closes
obligations.description: Last day for the Sellers' Representative to dispute the Earnout Statement. Runs from actual delivery; the date shown assumes delivery on the due date.
obligations.source_quote: The Sellers' Representative shall have thirty (30) days after delivery of an Earnout Statement to deliver a written notice of dispute.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Earnout Statement becomes final if no dispute notice is delivered.

obligations.title: FY2025 earnout payment (if earned)
obligations.description: $10M is payable if FY2025 Net Revenue is at least $48M; all-or-nothing, no partial payment. Earliest date shown assumes no dispute.

terms.notes: All-or-nothing: "No partial Earnout Payment shall be payable."

obligations.source_quote: Buyer shall pay any Earnout Payment that becomes payable within ten (10) Business Days after the final determination of Net Revenue for the applicable Fiscal Year.
obligations.due_date_basis: 'FY2025 earnout dispute window closes' + 10 business days (weekends skipped; holidays not modeled)

obligations.title: FY2026 Earnout Statement due
obligations.description: Buyer delivers its calculation of FY2026 Net Revenue to the Sellers' Representative.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the end of each of Fiscal Year 2025 and Fiscal Year 2026, Buyer shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative a statement setting forth its calculation of Net Revenue for such Fiscal Year (each, an "Earnout Statement").

obligations.title: FY2026 earnout dispute window closes
obligations.description: Last day for the Sellers' Representative to dispute the Earnout Statement. Runs from actual delivery; the date shown assumes delivery on the due date.
obligations.source_quote: The Sellers' Representative shall have thirty (30) days after delivery of an Earnout Statement to deliver a written notice of dispute.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Earnout Statement becomes final if no dispute notice is delivered.

obligations.title: FY2026 earnout payment (if earned)
obligations.description: $10M is payable if FY2026 Net Revenue is at least $58M; all-or-nothing, no partial payment. Earliest date shown assumes no dispute.

terms.notes: All-or-nothing: "No partial Earnout Payment shall be payable."

obligations.source_quote: Buyer shall pay any Earnout Payment that becomes payable within ten (10) Business Days after the final determination of Net Revenue for the applicable Fiscal Year.
obligations.due_date_basis: 'FY2026 earnout dispute window closes' + 10 business days (weekends skipped; holidays not modeled)

obligations.title: General reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring claims for breach of general representations and warranties.

terms.notes: $900K deductible; cap equals the Indemnity Escrow Amount.

obligations.source_quote: The representations and warranties of the Company and the Sellers contained in this Agreement (other than the Fundamental Representations and the Tax Representations) shall survive the Closing until the date that is eighteen (18) months after the Closing Date.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Claims for breach of general reps are barred.

obligations.title: Fundamental reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring claims for breach of Fundamental Representations.
obligations.source_quote: The Fundamental Representations shall survive the Closing until the date that is six (6) years after the Closing Date.

obligations.title: Tax reps survival ends
obligations.description: Tax representations survive until 60 days after the applicable statute of limitations expires. The date depends on each tax period.

timing.event_description: 60 days after expiry of the applicable statute of limitations

obligations.source_quote: The Tax Representations shall survive until sixty (60) days after the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations.
obligations.due_date_basis: 60 days after expiry of the applicable statute of limitations

obligations.title: Claim Notice response window
obligations.description: Indemnifying Party has 30 days after receiving a Claim Notice to object, or the claim is deemed accepted.

timing.event_description: 30 days after receipt of each Claim Notice

obligations.source_quote: The Indemnifying Party shall have thirty (30) days after receipt of a Claim Notice to deliver a written objection; if no objection is delivered within such period, the Indemnifying Party shall be deemed to have accepted the claim.
obligations.due_date_basis: 30 days after receipt of each Claim Notice

obligations.title: Key Seller non-compete expires
obligations.description: Elena Voss, Marcus Oyelaran and Priya Natarajan may not compete in the US or Canada until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For a period of five (5) years after the Closing Date, no Key Seller shall, directly or indirectly, engage in, own, manage or operate any business that competes with the Business anywhere in the United States or Canada.

obligations.title: Seller employee non-solicit expires
obligations.description: Sellers may not solicit or hire Company employees until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For a period of two (2) years after the Closing Date, no Seller shall, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or hire any employee of the Company.

obligations.title: D&O tail: no cancellation or amendment
obligations.description: Buyer must keep the Company from cancelling or modifying the 6-year D&O tail policy.
obligations.source_quote: Prior to the Closing, the Company shall purchase a six (6)-year "tail" directors' and officers' liability insurance policy, and for six (6) years after the Closing Date, Buyer shall cause the Company not to cancel, amend or otherwise modify such policy.

obligations.title: Pass through pre-closing tax refunds
obligations.description: Buyer must pay any Pre-Closing Tax Refund (net of costs) to the Sellers' Representative within 15 days of receipt.

timing.event_description: 15 days after receipt of each Pre-Closing Tax Refund

obligations.source_quote: Buyer shall pay to the Sellers' Representative, for the benefit of the Sellers, the amount of any Pre-Closing Tax Refund received by Buyer or the Company, net of reasonable out-of-pocket costs, within fifteen (15) days after receipt thereof.
obligations.due_date_basis: 15 days after receipt of each Pre-Closing Tax Refund

obligations.title: Retention bonus payments
obligations.description: $2M aggregate retention bonuses to Continuing Employees on Schedule 6.5 still employed at the first anniversary.
obligations.source_quote: On the first anniversary of the Closing Date, Buyer shall cause the Company to pay retention bonuses in an aggregate amount of $2,000,000 to the Continuing Employees listed on Schedule 6.5 who remain employed by the Company on such date.

outcomes.notes: No Objection Notice delivered; statement final.
$412,000 released to Buyer (working capital shortfall); $1,088,000 to Sellers.
Two listed employees departed before the anniversary.
$3.2M released; $1.3M retained against pending Claim Notice.
Claim Notice re: undisclosed breach of a top-10 customer contract.
FY2025 Net Revenue reported at $46.1M vs. $48.0M target: not earned per Buyer.
Sellers' Rep disputes revenue recognition on two multi-year contracts; referred to Independent Accountant.

obligations.title: Indemnity escrow release
obligations.description: The $8.5M indemnity escrow goes to Seller at the second anniversary, less unresolved claims. File any claim before this date.
obligations.source_quote: On the second anniversary of the Closing Date, the Escrow Agent shall release to Seller the then-remaining Indemnity Escrow Funds, less the amount of any unresolved claims set forth in Claim Notices delivered prior to such date.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Unclaimed escrow is released to Seller.

obligations.title: Environmental special escrow
obligations.description: $1.5M stays in escrow until the state agency issues a No Further Action letter for the Norfolk yard.

timing.event_description: Receipt of a No Further Action letter for the Norfolk Facility

obligations.source_quote: The Special Escrow Funds shall be released to Seller within ten (10) Business Days after Buyer's receipt of a No Further Action letter with respect to the Norfolk Facility.
obligations.due_date_basis: Receipt of a No Further Action letter for the Norfolk Facility

obligations.title: General reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring claims for breach of general representations.
obligations.source_quote: The representations and warranties contained in this Agreement shall survive the Closing until the second anniversary of the Closing Date, other than the Fundamental Representations, which shall survive until the sixth anniversary of the Closing Date.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Claims for breach of general reps are barred.

obligations.title: Fundamental reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring claims for breach of Fundamental Representations.
obligations.source_quote: The representations and warranties contained in this Agreement shall survive the Closing until the second anniversary of the Closing Date, other than the Fundamental Representations, which shall survive until the sixth anniversary of the Closing Date.

obligations.title: FY2025 EBITDA statement due
obligations.description: Buyer delivers FY2025 EBITDA to Seller for the earnout.
obligations.source_quote: Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of fiscal year 2025, Buyer shall deliver to Seller a statement of EBITDA for such fiscal year (the "EBITDA Statement").

obligations.title: FY2025 EBITDA review period ends
obligations.description: Seller has 45 days to object to the EBITDA Statement.
obligations.source_quote: Seller shall have forty-five (45) days after delivery of the EBITDA Statement to notify Buyer of any objection.

obligations.title: FY2025 earnout payment (if earned)
obligations.description: $7.5M if FY2025 EBITDA is at least $12M.
obligations.source_quote: Buyer shall pay the Earnout Payment, if any, within thirty (30) days after the EBITDA Statement becomes final.

obligations.title: Seller non-compete expires
obligations.description: Seller may not compete in marine services on the East Coast until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For a period of four (4) years following the Closing Date, Seller shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in the Business anywhere on the Atlantic seaboard of the United States.

outcomes.notes: Review period ran with no objection.

obligations.title: Closing Statement due
obligations.description: Parent delivers its calculation of closing working capital, cash and debt.
obligations.source_quote: Within sixty (60) days following the Closing Date, Parent shall prepare and deliver to the Stockholder Representative the Closing Statement.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Parent may lose the chance to run the adjustment on its own numbers.

obligations.title: Closing Statement objection window ends
obligations.description: Stockholder Representative has 30 days after delivery to object.
obligations.source_quote: The Stockholder Representative shall have thirty (30) days following delivery of the Closing Statement to deliver a Notice of Disagreement.

obligations.title: Holdback release
obligations.description: Parent pays the $2.1M holdback to stockholders, less pending claims.
obligations.source_quote: On the date that is twelve (12) months after the Closing Date, Parent shall pay to the Paying Agent, for further distribution to the Stockholders, the Holdback Amount, less any amounts subject to pending claims.

obligations.title: Deferred consideration payment
obligations.description: $5M fixed deferred payment on the second anniversary.
obligations.source_quote: On the second anniversary of the Closing Date, Parent shall pay the Deferred Consideration of $5,000,000 to the Paying Agent for distribution to the Stockholders.

obligations.title: ARR earnout statement due
obligations.description: Parent reports ARR at December 31, 2027. $6M is payable if ARR is at least $18M.
obligations.source_quote: Within seventy-five (75) days after December 31, 2027, Parent shall deliver to the Stockholder Representative a statement setting forth ARR as of such date.

obligations.title: Founder non-solicit expires
obligations.description: Founders may not solicit Lanternfish customers or employees until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For twenty-four (24) months following the Closing, no Founder shall solicit any customer or employee of the Company.

seller: Calder Point Capital Fund III, L.P. and other Sellers

obligations.title: Buyer's Closing Statement due
obligations.description: Buyer delivers its working capital calculation to the Sellers' Representative.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the Closing Date, Buyer shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative the Closing Statement.

obligations.title: Our objection deadline
obligations.description: Sellers' Representative (Calder Point) has 45 days to object to Buyer's numbers.
obligations.source_quote: The Sellers' Representative shall have forty-five (45) days after receipt of the Closing Statement to deliver an Objection Notice.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Buyer's Closing Statement becomes binding on Sellers.

obligations.title: Retention escrow release to Sellers
obligations.description: The $1.05M retention escrow (the R&W policy retention) comes back to Sellers, less pending claims.
obligations.source_quote: On the date that is fifteen (15) months after the Closing Date, the Escrow Agent shall release to Sellers the remaining Retention Escrow Amount, less the amount of any pending claims.

obligations.title: Buyer's claim window closes
obligations.description: After this date Buyer cannot bring general rep claims against Sellers; the R&W policy covers the rest.
obligations.source_quote: The representations and warranties of the Sellers shall survive the Closing until the date that is fifteen (15) months after the Closing Date.

obligations.title: Respond to Buyer's claim notice
obligations.description: Buyer's Claim Notice (received 14 Sep 2026) seeks $640K for unpaid pre-closing payroll taxes. Object in writing or it is deemed accepted.
obligations.source_quote: The Sellers' Representative shall have thirty (30) days after receipt of a Claim Notice to deliver a written objection thereto, failing which the claim shall be conclusively deemed a liability of the Sellers.
obligations.consequence_if_missed: Claim is deemed accepted and paid from the retention escrow.

obligations.title: Seller non-solicit expires
obligations.description: Calder Point and its affiliates may not solicit Tessera employees until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For two (2) years following the Closing Date, no Seller shall, and each Seller shall cause its Affiliates not to, solicit for employment any Company Employee.

outcomes.notes: Reviewed with deal team; no objection. Sellers received a $1.1M upward adjustment.

seller: Founders of Juniper Cold Chain Logistics, Inc.

obligations.title: Indemnity escrow release
obligations.description: $10.5M indemnity escrow to Sellers at 18 months, less pending claims.
obligations.source_quote: Eighteen (18) months after the Closing Date, the Escrow Agent shall release the Indemnity Escrow Amount to the Sellers, less the amount of any pending claims.

obligations.title: General reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring general rep claims.
obligations.source_quote: The general representations and warranties shall survive the Closing for eighteen (18) months.

obligations.title: Fundamental reps survival ends
obligations.description: Last day to bring claims on title, capitalization and authority.
obligations.source_quote: The Fundamental Representations shall survive the Closing for five (5) years.

obligations.title: FY2025 EBITDA statement due
obligations.description: Buyer reports FY2025 EBITDA; $12M is payable if it reaches $20M.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the end of each of fiscal years 2025 and 2026, Buyer shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative a statement of EBITDA for such fiscal year.

obligations.title: FY2026 EBITDA statement due
obligations.description: Buyer reports FY2026 EBITDA; $15M is payable if it reaches $22M.
obligations.source_quote: Within ninety (90) days after the end of each of fiscal years 2025 and 2026, Buyer shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative a statement of EBITDA for such fiscal year.

obligations.title: Founder non-compete expires
obligations.description: Founders may not compete in cold-chain logistics in North America until this date.
obligations.source_quote: For five (5) years after the Closing Date, no Founder shall engage in the cold-chain logistics business in North America.

obligations.title: D&O tail: keep in force
obligations.description: Buyer must not cancel the 6-year D&O tail.
obligations.source_quote: For six (6) years after the Closing, Buyer shall not cause the D&O Tail Policy to be cancelled or modified.

outcomes.notes: Released in full; no claims pending.
FY2025 EBITDA $19.8M vs. $20.0M target: not earned. Sellers did not dispute.
